universe.es: peticiones a /v1/identity/* con operador VERIFICADO por ASN oficial, excluido todo lo propio (misma semantica que el gate)
universe.en: requests to /v1/identity/* from an operator VERIFIED by official ASN, with everything of ours excluded (same semantics as the gate)

how_to_recompute.es: cada `gaps` es la lista COMPLETA de intervalos (en segundos) entre dos peticiones consecutivas de esa familia a la MISMA URL, ya filtrados por el suelo de rafaga. La mediana del panel es quantile_cont(gaps, 0.5) / 3600. Sin muestreo: si la lista se recortara, el percentil recomputado seria otro.
how_to_recompute.en: each `gaps` is the COMPLETE list of intervals (in seconds) between two consecutive requests from that family to the SAME URL, already filtered by the burst floor. The panel's median is quantile_cont(gaps, 0.5) / 3600. No sampling: if the list were truncated, the recomputed percentile would be a different number.
